text:
- Locate pillbottle and blue_pad first; if either is not visible or positions are inconsistent, home and re-locate with descriptions before grasping.
- Use the named arm; if unspecified, either arm. Grasp the bottle body centre; if EMPTY_GRASP/UNREACHABLE, re-locate and retry, not the same failed grasp.
- Place with ref blue_pad, relation "on". Avoid align=true or explicit xy if they cause PLAN_FAIL/OFF_TARGET; after OFF_TARGET or a fall, home, re-locate, re-grasp, and place again.
- A bottle lying on its side does not count even on the pad, and place does not stand a lying bottle back up; grasp gently so it is not knocked over, and do not use "against" unless instructed.
- Before done, verify on, upright, released, and centred via locate/placed_offset; bottom_z near pad top and centre height consistent with an upright bottle.
goal: Pillbottle upright, centred on blue_pad, released, bottom near pad top, centre height consistent with bottle height.
